cards.card_text: True or false: the LORD says He will chastise only the worst of them.
cards.verse_text: The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I will chastise them all.
cards.snippet: The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I will chastise them all.

cards.card_text: He'll bring them down like birds of the air and chastise them when He hears them flocking together.
cards.verse_text: I will chastise them when I hear them flocking together.
cards.snippet: I will chastise them when I hear them flocking together.
